name: Scout Door Fixture (temporary test card)
offer: A temporary fixture card placed by Scout to test the Briarwood submission door from outside. It offers nothing and is removed after the test.

terms.scope: Testing only. This fixture performs no service for anyone.
terms.time: It exists only for the length of the door test on 2026-10-26.
terms.cost: Free. It charges nothing and pays nothing.
terms.consequences: If the door accepts it, the pointer it creates is removed the same day and the fixture files are deleted.
terms.decision: Scout decides. This fixture is a test instrument, not a member.

how_checked: It is checked by the Briarwood submission door itself, which is what is being tested.
